seeds.scene: Four photos of the same courtyard sundial taken at different times of day; shadows point at: long-westward, short-northward, long-eastward, medium-northwest. Frames labeled randomly W, X, Y, Z.
seeds.question: What is the correct chronological order of the frames from morning to evening?
seeds.answer: morning long-westward → noon short-northward → afternoon medium-northwest → evening long-eastward (or per actual frame mapping)
seeds.lever: Map shadow length and direction to time of day; order accordingly.

seeds.scene: A Gantt-chart calendar with 5 tasks T1-T5 and dependencies; each task lasts 1 week. T1 must finish before T2 and T3, T4 needs T2+T3 done, T5 needs T4 done. Start week 1.
seeds.question: What is the EARLIEST week T5 can start?
seeds.answer: week 4 (T1 in W1, T2&T3 in W2, T4 in W3, T5 starts W4)
seeds.lever: Resolve DAG critical path through finish-to-start dependencies.

seeds.scene: Two photos of a digital stopwatch: photo 1 shows '12:34:56', photo 2 shows '13:01:09'.
seeds.question: How much time elapsed between the photos?
seeds.lever: Subtract two timestamps including hh:mm:ss arithmetic with carry.

seeds.scene: Two photos of the same candle: photo 1 shows full 15 cm candle, photo 2 shows 9 cm remaining. Burn rate sticker says 'this candle burns 1 cm/hour'.
seeds.question: How long has elapsed between the two photos?
seeds.lever: Apply burn rate to length difference to compute elapsed time.

seeds.scene: Four photos of an ice block melting on a counter, labeled randomly: 100% intact, 60% remaining with some pooling, 25% with large puddle, fully melted (just water).
seeds.question: Order from earliest to latest.
seeds.lever: Order monotone-decreasing ice mass with pooling water as confirmation.

seeds.scene: Two photos of the same north-facing window taken at noon: one in June (no direct sunlight reaches the window), one in December (no direct sunlight either, but ambient light from low sun differs subtly).
seeds.question: Which photo was taken in winter?
seeds.answer: the one with longer apparent shadow indoor and warmer light angle
seeds.lever: Infer season from sun-angle proxy (shadow length, light color).

seeds.scene: Two adjacent wall clocks; left reads 3:42, right reads 3:48. A note: 'left is the official correct clock.'
seeds.question: Is the right clock ahead or behind, and by how much?
seeds.lever: Compare two clocks against reference and compute offset and direction.

seeds.scene: A daily appointment book showing time slots with handwritten meetings: 9-10 'standup', 10:30-11:30 'planning', 11-12 'design review', 1-2 'lunch'.
seeds.question: Are any meetings overlapping?
seeds.lever: Detect time-interval overlaps in a schedule.

seeds.scene: A wall with horizontal pencil marks at increasing heights, each labeled with date: 2018-1m, 2019-1.1m, 2020-1.2m, 2021-1.3m, 2022-1.4m. A new mark today reads 1.5m, undated.
seeds.question: What is the most likely date of the new mark, by trend?
seeds.lever: Extrapolate linear growth trend to date the new mark.

seeds.scene: An hourglass egg timer showing approximately 2/3 of sand still in the top half; total runtime is 3 minutes.
seeds.question: Approximately how much time remains?
seeds.lever: Map sand-remaining ratio to remaining time.

seeds.scene: Four wardrobe photos with the front-facing outfits: 1 heavy coat, 2 light jacket, 3 t-shirt and shorts, 4 sweater. Random order; northern-hemisphere assumed.
seeds.question: Order them from January to December chronologically.
seeds.answer: heavy coat → light jacket → t-shirt → sweater (roughly winter→spring→summer→fall)
seeds.lever: Order outfits by inferred season.

seeds.scene: A cinema marquee: showtimes 'Movie A: 2:00 PM start, 4:25 PM end. Includes 10 min intermission.'
seeds.question: What is the actual runtime of the movie excluding intermission?
seeds.lever: Compute total elapsed minus stated breaks.

seeds.scene: A train board: depart 14:30, scheduled trip 2h 45m, train delayed 35 minutes.
seeds.question: What is the projected arrival time?
seeds.lever: Add scheduled time and delay to departure.

seeds.scene: A multi-frame photo of a bouncing ball; in 4 evenly-spaced frames the ball moves 50 cm, 30 cm, 20 cm, 5 cm.
seeds.question: Is the ball speeding up or slowing down?
seeds.lever: Compare per-frame displacement deltas to infer acceleration sign.

seeds.scene: A monthly calendar with a recurring weekly meeting marked every Tuesday. May 2026 begins on Friday.
seeds.question: How many Tuesday meetings are in May 2026?
seeds.lever: Count weekday occurrences in a month given start day-of-week.

seeds.scene: A wall with three clocks labeled NY, LON, TOK. NY shows 9:00 AM. A note: 'meeting is at 9 AM Tokyo time.'
seeds.question: What time is the meeting in NY?
seeds.answer: 8 PM the previous day (Tokyo is 14h ahead of NY EDT, depending on DST)
seeds.lever: Apply timezone offset to convert meeting time to local.

seeds.scene: A package tracking screen: status 'shipped 2025-04-30', expected delivery 'within 3-5 business days'. Shipping carrier doesn't deliver Sundays. Question evaluated at 2025-05-05 (Mon).
seeds.question: Has the delivery window started, ended, or is it ongoing?
seeds.answer: ongoing (3 business days = May 5; 5 business days = May 7)
seeds.lever: Compute business-day arithmetic excluding Sundays.

seeds.scene: Four recipe-step photos: dough mixed in bowl, dough rising in covered bowl, dough shaped into loaf, baked golden loaf. Random order.
seeds.question: What is the correct sequence?
seeds.lever: Order procedural steps by causal dependency.

seeds.scene: Five photos of a sunflower's growth: seed, sprout, sapling with leaves, budding, full bloom. Random order.
seeds.question: Order them from earliest to latest.
seeds.answer: seed → sprout → sapling → budding → full bloom
seeds.lever: Order biological growth stages.

seeds.scene: A swimlane chart with 3 workers; tasks have durations and assignments: W1 has T1(2d) then T4(1d); W2 has T2(3d); W3 has T3(1d) then T5(2d). All workers start day 1.
seeds.question: What is the EARLIEST day all tasks finish?
seeds.lever: Compute max across worker timelines for project finish.
